content.content: deccy new --on naming any id resolving to no node file refuses before creating anything and names each unknown id; nothing is created.
content.rationale: Requiring --on keeps every birth placed, so any unplaced birth must refuse before birth — a created node with a dangling depends_on would break resolvability; refusing atomic over the whole --on set keeps partial births out, and naming each unknown id makes the refusal actionable without re-deciding resolution.
